text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-san, happy birthday! I'll give you 
your present later!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
From me, some merch from that game you 
mentioned liking before. And from 
Brian-san—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... I appreciate you celebrating, 
but... How did both of you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I heard from my big sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I heard all about it from Ticket-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, those two...! Even though I told them 
they didn't have to do anything...! 
Jeez—...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Was I, by any chance, bothering 
you...? I just thought, "Let's all 
celebrate together with the whole class!" 
and went ahead and prepared it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Running away will only make it more of 
a hassle. Every single one of them was 
getting way too carried away, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, y-you're in on it too...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez............ It wasn't a bother at 
all. —Thanks, you two.
